description: Work with Time Doctor: read tracked time and manual time edits, manage projects, tasks and groups, invite people, and start workflows when someone joins, a group is made, time is tracked or time is edited.

time_doctor_new_group_trigger.description: Runs when a group (a team or department) is created in your Time Doctor company. Groups already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.creatorId: The id of the user who created it
output.managers: The ids of the group's managers
output.name: The group's name
output.users: How many people are in it

time_doctor_new_time_edit_trigger.description: Runs when someone adds or removes time by hand on the last 14 days of their timesheet, with the reason and whether it's approved. Edits already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.projectId: The project the time is for
output.taskId: The task the time is for
output.userId: The id of the person whose time it is

parameters.description: Only this person. Leave empty for everyone you can see.
parameters.name: member_id

parameters.description: Only edits in this state: pending (waiting for approval), approved, disapproved or autoApproved. Leave empty for all.
parameters.name: approval

time_doctor_new_user_trigger.description: Runs when someone is added to your Time Doctor company, with their name, email, role and when they joined. People already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.employeeId: Your own id for them, if set
output.name: Their full name
output.role: owner, admin, manager, user or guest

parameters.description: Only people in this group. Leave empty for everyone.
parameters.name: group_id

time_doctor_time_tracked_trigger.description: Runs for each stretch of work someone finishes tracking, with its start, end, length in seconds, task and project. A stretch starts the workflow about 10 minutes after it ends.

output.key: What marks this stretch as seen
output.mode: How it was tracked: computer, mobile, manual, offline and so on
output.userId: The id of the person who tracked it

parameters.description: Only this person. Leave empty for everyone you can see.
parameters.name: member_id
